Playing Secluded Steppe (tapped, produces W) turn 1, then Mountain turn 2 gives R+W on turn 2, then another land turn 3 for potentially 3 mana including W for Monologue Tax. Actually, the sequencing of tapped lands first is correct in principle, but Secluded Steppe would have been better than Forgotten Cave since it produces white mana needed for the commander and Monologue Tax.
